test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The little girl walked slowly ________ her burden.
solution:
The correct answer is **bearing.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bear: **carry the weight of; support.
 
• **Store: **a supply of something that is kept for future use; the place where it is kept.
 
• **Hold: **to keep something in a certain position.
 
• **Load: **​to put a large quantity of something into or onto somebody/something.
 
• The sentence is expressing the fact that the little girl was walking slowly as she was burdened by her weight.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **'****bearing'**.
